summary: Telesat Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026, announcing an agreement in principle with Canada's Defence Investment Agency for Telesat Lightspeed services to provide Mil-Ka-band Arctic connectivity to the Canadian Armed Forces under the ESCP-P program. This is a routine commercial agreement for government services, not a special situation. The filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or any other listed special situation categories. The agreement is subject to a definitive contract expected in weeks with no material impact on Telesat's Q1 2028 service delivery timeline. No financial terms were disclosed.
